title: One-plug umbilical
lede: Countertop version with neodymium. Real John Guest PP0408W unions and pogo pair, K&J B633 bars; the socket, plug and bundle are new.

panels.name: Machine side
panels.caption: Four 1/4″ holes and the pogo on end with its two M1.4 screws. The B633 bars are sealed under 1.2 mm of PET-GF, so the face shows only those. Ø32.3 socket.

panels.name: Plug
panels.caption: Ø31.7 end to end. Four 24.5 mm stubs and the pogo pads; the two B633 bars are sealed under the face.

panels.name: Plugged in
panels.caption: The bars meet through both 1.2 mm covers, 2.4 mm apart. N faces out on one side and S on the other, so an upside-down plug pushes away instead of seating.

panels.name: Behind the face
panels.caption: All four unions at one depth, 15.6 mm apart, collets 8.5 mm behind the face: the depth the pogo's M1.4 inserts and 8 mm screws need. The bars sit sealed in pockets in front of the unions, dropped in at a print pause like the cartridge's RC62s.

panels.name: Through the counter
panels.caption: The Ø31.7 plug in the 1⅜″ (Ø34.93) countertop hole: 1.6 mm a side.
